answer: Graph-conductance scoring resists Sybil attacks by seeding short random walks from a summit of verified anchors across peer-endorsement edges. Because sparse attack edges act as a narrow inlet, normalizing walk rank by node degree dilutes leaked trust across fake clusters, keeping each fake identity as minor as a sparrow. Attackers must earn scarce genuine endorsements per identity, though bribed nodes can still sell edges and newcomers face cold-start exclusion.
